using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Library;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities.Tests
{
    public class FolderTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void GetActualChildrenDictionary_LogsError_OnDuplicateIds()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<Folder>>();
            var folder = new Folder
            {
                Path = "/test/path",
                Name = "Test Folder"
            };
            folder.Logger = logger.Object;

            var child1 = new Mock<BaseItem>();
            child1.Setup(c => c.Id).Returns(Guid.NewGuid());
            child1.Setup(c => c.Path).Returns("/test/child1");
            child1.Setup(c => c.Name).Returns("Child1");

            var child2 = new Mock<BaseItem>();
            child2.Setup(c => c.Id).Returns(child1.Object.Id); // Duplicate ID
            child2.Setup(c => c.Path).Returns("/test/child2");
            child2.Setup(c => c.Name).Returns("Child2");

            var children = new[] { child1.Object, child2.Object };
            folder.GetType().GetField("_children", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(folder, children);

            // Act
            var result = folder.GetActualChildrenDictionary();

            // Assert
            logger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>(
                        s => s.ToString().Contains("Found folder containing items with duplicate id. Path: /test/path, Child Name: /test/child2")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>()),
                Times.Once);
            
            Assert.Single(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void GetActualChildrenDictionary_ReturnsDictionaryWithUniqueItems()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<Folder>>();
            var folder = new Folder { Logger = logger.Object };

            var child1 = new Mock<BaseItem>();
            var id1 = Guid.NewGuid();
            child1.Setup(c => c.Id).Returns(id1);

            var child2 = new Mock<BaseItem>();
            var id2 = Guid.NewGuid();
            child2.Setup(c => c.Id).Returns(id2);

            var children = new[] { child1.Object, child2.Object };
            folder.GetType().GetField("_children", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?.SetValue(folder, children);

            // Act
            var result = folder.GetActualChildrenDictionary();

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal(2, result.Count);
            Assert.Equal(child1.Object, result[id1]);
            Assert.Equal(child2.Object, result[id2]);
            logger.Verify(l => l.Log(It.IsAny<LogLevel>(), It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyFormat>(), It.IsAny<Exception>()), Times.Never);
        }
    }
}
